 Cristiano Ronaldo upstaged by England star as Al-Nassr beaten
 Sam Brookes Friday 20 November 2026 14:37 EST 
 Bookmark popover
 Removed from bookmarks
 Close popover Cristiano Ronaldo's Al-Nassr lost on Friday night ( Reuters ) Cristiano Ronaldo ’s Al-Nassr slipped to a 3-1 defeat against Al-Ahli in the Saudi Pro League on Friday night.
 Ronaldo put Al-Nassr in front in the 14th minute as he moved closer to the milestone of 1,000 career goals.
 However, Al-Ahli hit back with an equaliser on the stroke of half time through Galeno, following an assist from England striker Ivan Toney .
 Toney then got on the scoresheet himself, tucking home a 71st-minute penalty to put Al-Ahli ahead for the first time.
 Al-Ahli defender Roger Ibanez wrapped up the victory for his side with 15 minutes remaining on a disappointing night for Ronaldo and his teammates.
